in_sanskrit.name: ऋत्विज्
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit word 'Rit' which means 'Ritual' and 'Vik' which means 'One who performs or knows the rituals'. A person who is knowledgeable in the Vedas and performs religious rituals.

in_hindi.name: रित्विक
in_hindi.long_meaning: संस्कृत वर्णनात्मक शब्द 'रित्' से उत्पन्न हुए 'विज्' का साथित या जाननेवाला। वेदों का पाठक या पूजारी।

in_tamil.name: இரித்விக்
